# Enterplace

> Self-hosted AI gateway, open source (MIT core). Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI), apps and MCP clients call models through it. Each request gets a person's name, a budget, guardrails and a line in a tamper-evident audit log. One Docker image plus Postgres, in your own cloud. Claude Code users keep their own subscription login.

Install and start: `curl -fsSL https://enterplace.dev/install.sh | sh` then `enterplace start`.
